abstract: This paper studies why market growth did not fragment Chile’s vocational higher education sector. First-year enrollment grew 112% from 2005 to 2018, while the top four institutions’ share rose from 52.9% to 66.2%. Using Sutton’s endogenous sunk cost framework, we examine concentration, entry, and vertical differentiation. Censored quantile regressions yield positive estimated lower-envelope minima for C1 and the HHI over the observed market-size range. Exploiting geographic entry by dominant institutions, we find that smaller incumbents lose about 75% of enrollment and 43% of program variety within two years. Institutional-choice, retention, and graduate-wage evidence also points to vertical differentiation. Together, these findings document non-fragmentation and persistent displacement in a labor-intensive service industry. They are consistent with endogenous sunk costs in reputation, although the data do not directly identify the response of reputational investment to market size or rule out persistent exogenous quality differences.
abstract_zh: 本文研究为何市场增长未使智利职业高等教育部门碎片化。2005年至2018年，一年级入学人数增长了112%，而前四大机构的市场份额从52.9%上升至66.2%。运用Sutton的内生沉没成本框架，我们考察了集中度、进入和垂直差异化。删失分位数回归在观测到的市场规模范围内，对C1和HHI给出了正的下包络最小值估计。利用主导机构的地理进入，我们发现较小的现有机构在两年内损失约75%的入学人数和43%的项目种类。机构选择、留存率和毕业生工资方面的证据也指向垂直差异化。综合来看，这些发现记录了一个劳动密集型服务行业中的非碎片化和持续性替代。它们与声誉方面的内生沉没成本相一致，尽管数据并未直接识别声誉投资对市场规模的响应，也未排除持续存在的外生质量差异。
title: Endogenous sunk costs and market structure in Vocational Higher Education
title_zh: 内生沉没成本与高等职业教育市场结构

abstract: Input-output linkages among sectors and firms are largely overlooked when assessing regulatory policies. Using a carbon emissions regulation in China as an example, we find that the regulation facilitates the transition to green technologies and reduces entry and carbon emissions in the regulated sectors with large carbon emissions. We also find unintended spillovers via the input-output network, resulting in more entry and innovation in the downstream sectors; and less entry and innovation in the upstream sectors. These facts can be rationalized by a firm-dynamics model with input-output linkages. The results of quantitative exercises are substantially different when taking input-output linkages into account.
abstract_zh: 在评估监管政策时，部门和企业之间的投入产出联系在很大程度上被忽视。以中国的碳排放监管为例，我们发现该监管促进了向绿色技术的转型，并减少了碳排放量大的受监管部门的进入和碳排放。我们还发现，通过投入产出网络产生了非预期的溢出效应，导致下游部门的进入和创新增加，而上游部门的进入和创新减少。这些事实可以通过一个具有投入产出联系的企业动态模型加以合理解释。当考虑投入产出联系时，定量练习的结果存在显著差异。

abstract: I examine the US-born labor market impacts of the Chinese Exclusion Act of 1882, America’s first significant immigration restriction, which prohibited the entry of Chinese laborers. Using linked Census data for over two million US workers, I find that US-born workers exposed to the Chinese Exclusion had lower occupational income in 1900, with effects strongest for low-skilled workers. I provide evidence suggesting low-skilled US-born workers likely benefited from the low-skilled labor shortage through higher wages in the short-run, but this led to lower human capital investment and occupational stagnation in the long-run.
abstract_zh: 我考察了1882年《排华法案》对美国本土出生劳动力市场的影响。该法案是美国首个重要的移民限制法案，禁止华工入境。利用超过两百万美国工人的关联人口普查数据，我发现，在1900年，受《排华法案》影响的本土出生工人职业收入更低，且这一效应对低技能工人最为显著。我提供的证据表明，低技能本土出生工人可能因低技能劳动力短缺而在短期内通过更高工资受益，但这导致了长期人力资本投资下降和职业停滞。

title: The hinge of the golden door: Labor market impacts of immigrant exclusion
title_zh: 金门之铰：移民排斥的劳动力市场影响

abstract: State-led collaborative supply chain governance (SLCSCG) models bring together governments, businesses, and other key stakeholders while emphasizing a top-down design, central coordination, and local implementation. We employ EDGAR grid emission data for 3,851 A-share listed firms over the sample period 2011–2022 and adopt a difference-in-differences (DID) identification strategy. We estimate that, on average, China’s city-level supply chain innovation and application pilot (CLSCIAP) policy, a distinctive example of SLCSCG, has reduced carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions by 10.0%. We have identified mechanisms that mitigate firms’ abnormal investments, promote their carbon disclosure, and improve supply chain proximity, which are explicitly targeted by the policy tasks. Further analysis reveals an asymmetric policy spillover effect, from treated customers to their upstream suppliers, demonstrating the pivotal role of customer firms in decarbonizing supply chains. Building on two unresolved questions of how state coordination supports decarbonization and how policy effects propagate along supply chains, this study provides a new empirical basis for understanding the roles of central authority and multi-stakeholder collaboration in green governance. It also demonstrates that such an integrated policy achieves significant emission reduction effects via complementary firm-level and supply-chain-level channels, verifying its effectiveness and scalability in promoting sustainability transitions.
abstract_zh: 政府主导的协同供应链治理（SLCSCG）模式将政府、企业及其他关键利益相关方汇聚在一起，同时强调自上而下的设计、集中协调与地方实施。我们采用2011—2022年样本期内3，851家A股上市公司的EDGAR网格排放数据，并采用双重差分（DID）识别策略。我们估计，作为SLCSCG的一个独特范例，中国城市级供应链创新与应用试点（CLSCIAP）政策平均使二氧化碳（CO2）排放降低了10.0%。我们识别出该政策任务明确针对的若干机制，包括抑制企业的异常投资、促进其碳披露以及提升供应链邻近度。进一步分析揭示了一种非对称的政策溢出效应，即从受处理的客户企业向其上游供应商传导，表明客户企业在供应链脱碳中发挥关键作用。本研究围绕国家协调如何支持脱碳以及政策效应如何沿供应链传导这两个尚未解决的问题，为理解中央权威与多利益相关方协作在绿色治理中的作用提供了新的经验依据。研究还表明，这种综合性政策通过企业层面与供应链层面的互补渠道实现了显著的减排效果，验证了其在推动可持续转型方面的有效性与可扩展性。

title: Can state-led collaborative supply chain governance catalyse decarbonization of firms and supply chains? Evidence from China’s supply chain innovation and application pilot
title_zh: 国家主导的协同供应链治理能否催化企业与供应链脱碳？——来自中国供应链创新与应用试点的证据

abstract: This paper estimates the dynamic price effects of supply chain shortage shocks on 31 critical minerals over the period June 2009 to January 2026. Mineral-level structural vector autoregressions identify exogenous shortage innovations, and panel local projections trace their cumulative impact over a 36-month horizon. Worsening scarcity generates rapid and persistent price increases, while responses to easing scarcity are less precisely estimated. The evidence supports asymmetric price responses at several horizons, but does not establish that easing shortages have no price effect. Furthermore, supply concentration amplifies the price response, with minerals whose production is dominated by a few countries exhibiting substantially larger cumulative price gains than those with diversified supply structures, and a continuous interaction specification confirms that the amplification scales smoothly with the Herfindahl–Hirschman Index. Additionally, the effect is heterogeneous across end-use categories, with electric-vehicle and battery minerals showing the strongest sensitivity. All results are robust to alternative lag specifications and to replacing the text-based shortage index with the Global Supply Chain Pressure Index.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了2009年6月至2026年1月期间供应链短缺冲击对31种关键矿物的动态价格效应。矿物层面的结构向量自回归识别外生短缺冲击，面板局部投影追踪其在36个月期限内的累积影响。稀缺性加剧会引发快速且持续的价格上涨，而对稀缺性缓解的响应估计则不够精确。证据支持在多个期限上存在非对称价格响应，但并未证实短缺缓解没有价格效应。此外，供应集中度会放大价格响应，生产由少数国家主导的矿物相比供应结构多元化的矿物表现出显著更大的累积价格涨幅，连续交互设定证实这种放大效应随赫芬达尔—赫希曼指数平滑变化。此外，该效应在不同终端用途类别间存在异质性，电动汽车和电池矿物表现出最强的敏感性。所有结果在替代滞后设定以及用全球供应链压力指数替换基于文本的短缺指数后均保持稳健。
title: How do supply chain disruptions affect critical mineral prices?
title_zh: 供应链中断如何影响关键矿产价格？

abstract: The technological progress plays a key role in co-benefits of carbon mitigation and air pollution reduction in China, especially for renewable energy. Exogenous technological progress such as autonomous energy efficiency improvement (AEEI) as non-price factor driving sector energy efficiency improvement is commonly used for macroeconomic models which relies on subjective cognition derived from modeling experience. In contrast, endogenous technological improvement such as learning-by-doing (LBD) embeds relationship between technological improvement and energy costs, especially in renewable energy sector. Although comparison between cost-effectiveness of decarbonization of different technological progress is regarded as important, the ripple effects of different technological progress in renewable energy development on decarbonization pathways at industrial level is ignored. This study aims to figure out whether LBD-empowered renewable energy is better for modeling policy effects of air pollution reduction and decarbonization, demonstrating the different decarbonization pathways induced by LBD and AEEI through computable general equilibrium (CGE) model. Our results reveal that cheaper renewable energy attributed to LBD is more conducive to low-carbon transition compared to AEEI, by examining different ripple effects of two technological innovation of renewable energy on high-emission and service sector, thereby macro economy through two-model comparison. However, for comparability of two CGE models, higher total factor productivity (TFP) under AEEI model is calibrated compared to LBD model under same GDP growth rate, which lead to lower energy efficiency in the latter model. In other words, low-carbon transition ignoring LBD in renewable energy sector might underestimate impacts of TFP improved by endogenous LBD of renewable energy on economic growth. Our study also gives policy insights that environmental policy designing should take LBD mechanism of renewable energy into consideration of modeling decarbonization pathway in China because current AEEI setting might overstate its contribution to economic growth and ripple effects on other sectors.
abstract_zh: 技术进步在中国碳减排与空气污染减排的协同效益中发挥关键作用，尤其是可再生能源领域。外生技术进步，如自主能效改进（AEEI）作为推动部门能效提升的非价格因素，常被用于宏观经济模型，其依赖于建模经验所衍生的主观认知。相比之下，内生技术进步，如干中学（LBD），将技术进步与能源成本之间的关系内嵌，尤其在可再生能源部门。尽管不同技术进步在脱碳成本有效性方面的比较被视为重要，但可再生能源发展中不同技术进步对产业层面脱碳路径的涟漪效应却被忽视。本研究旨在厘清LBD驱动的可再生能源是否更有利于模拟空气污染减排与脱碳的政策效应，通过可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型展示LBD与AEEI所引致的不同脱碳路径。我们的结果表明，通过两模型比较考察可再生能源两种技术创新对高排放部门和服务部门、进而通过宏观经济产生的不同涟漪效应，归因于LBD的更廉价可再生能源相较于AEEI更有利于低碳转型。然而，为两CGE模型的可比性，在相同GDP增长率下，AEEI模型校准了相较于LBD模型更高的全要素生产率（TFP），导致后者模型能效更低。换言之，忽视可再生能源部门LBD的低碳转型可能低估可再生能源内生LBD所提升的TFP对经济增长的影响。本研究亦给出政策启示：环境政策设计应将可再生能源的LBD机制纳入中国脱碳路径建模考量，因为当前AEEI设定可能高估其对经济增长的贡献及对其他部门的涟漪效应。

title: Is endogenous technical change better for modeling co-benefits of air pollution control and carbon abatement in China? A comparative analysis of LBD and AEEI of renewable energy based on CGE model
title_zh: 内生性技术变化是否更有利于中国空气污染控制与碳减排协同效益的建模？基于CGE模型的可再生能源LBD与AEEI比较分析

abstract: Public investment can be used to affect the economy over the business cycle, but also to boost its long-term potential. However, public investment is often subject to delays related to planning, construction, or both. We show that these delays can affect the usefulness of public investment for managing the economy. In the case of a downturn, a delay in delivering an announced public investment can worsen the downturn if public investment is not delivered quickly. If public investment that has been planned during the recession is delayed so that it occurs when the recession is over, it risks overheating the economy. Delays in the delivery of public investment shift the benefits from higher public capital further into the future and reduce welfare. These findings hold in the standard model as well as in the model with search frictions, but with search frictions planning delays become less concerning, because the business cycle induced by the delay becomes smoother.
abstract_zh: 公共投资可用于在经济周期中影响经济，也可用于提升其长期潜力。然而，公共投资往往因规划、建设或两者兼有而出现延迟。我们表明，这些延迟会影响公共投资用于管理经济的有效性。在下行期，如果公共投资未能迅速到位，已宣布的公共投资交付延迟可能加剧下行。如果衰退期间规划的公共投资被延迟至衰退结束后才发生，则可能使经济过热。公共投资交付延迟将更高公共资本带来的收益进一步推迟至未来，并降低福利。这些发现在标准模型中成立，在带有搜索摩擦的模型中也成立，但在搜索摩擦下，规划延迟变得不那么令人担忧，因为延迟引发的经济周期变得更加平滑。
title: Delivering public investment efficiently: If possible, avoid delays
title_zh: 高效提供公共投资：尽可能避免延误

abstract: This study examines the structure and evolution of global trade networks for four major edible oils (palm, soybean, sunflower, and canola) over 2013–2022 using descriptive multilayer network analysis, commodity-specific temporal exponential random graph models (TERGMs), and cross-commodity ERGM specifications. Network diagnostics reveal substantial heterogeneity across commodities in centrality, clustering, and community structure, together with notable network reorganization around periods of geopolitical and market disruption. The temporal models show strong stability in bilateral trade states and significant triadic closure, indicating that trade connectivity is strongly associated with prior network states and surrounding network structure not accounted for in a conditionally independent dyadic (gravity) specification. Nonetheless, gravity-type relationships remain clearly evident in TERGMs: distance is negatively associated with trade connectivity, whereas contiguity and regional trade agreements are positively associated with bilateral links. A major contrast arises in the association between inter-state conflict exposure and trade connectivity: negative and statistically significant across all four commodity-specific TERGMs; and not statistically significant in the matched extensive-margin gravity benchmark. Cross-commodity entrainment is also positive and highly significant in 2014, 2018, and 2022 snapshot models, indicating systematic bilateral embeddedness across edible-oil markets, which is robust to alternative network specifications. Overall, the results show the joint importance of temporal and endogenous network dependence, cross-commodity embeddedness, and geopolitical exposure to global edible-oil trade, while gravity-type relationships remain relevant. These findings highlight the need to consider both within-commodity and cross-commodity network structure when evaluating supply-chain concentration, geopolitical exposure, and potential trade-adjustment pathways.
abstract_zh: 本研究运用描述性多层网络分析、特定商品的时间指数随机图模型（TERGMs）以及跨商品ERGM设定，考察了2013—2022年间四种主要食用油（棕榈油、大豆油、葵花籽油和菜籽油）全球贸易网络的结构与演化。网络诊断显示，各商品在中介中心性、聚类和社区结构方面存在显著异质性，并在地缘政治和市场扰动时期出现明显的网络重组。时间模型显示双边贸易状态具有强稳定性，且三元闭合显著，表明贸易连通性与先前网络状态及条件独立二元（引力）设定未涵盖的周边网络结构密切相关。尽管如此，引力型关系在TERGMs中仍清晰可见：距离与贸易连通性负相关，而接壤和区域贸易协定与双边联系正相关。主要反差出现在国家间冲突暴露与贸易连通性的关联上：在四个特定商品TERGMs中均呈负向且统计显著；而在匹配的广延边际引力基准中不具统计显著性。跨商品裹挟在2014、2018和2022年快照模型中也呈正向且高度显著，表明食用油市场间存在系统性双边嵌入性，且对替代网络设定具有稳健性。总体而言，结果表明时间与内生网络依赖、跨商品嵌入性和地缘政治暴露对全球食用油贸易的共同重要性，而引力型关系仍然相关。这些发现凸显了在评估供应链集中度、地缘政治暴露和潜在贸易调整路径时，需同时考虑商品内与跨商品网络结构。
title: Beyond gravity: Geopolitics and multilayer network dependence in global edible-oil trade
title_zh: 超越引力：全球食用油贸易中的地缘政治与多层网络依赖

abstract: We study the impact of the green transition and automation on the labor market, drawing on the European Labor Force Survey and Dutch administrative data spanning the past two decades. First, we consider changes in job stocks in the EU-14. Second, we identify individual and occupational drivers of transition-related occupational switches in the Netherlands Third, we use an event-study approach to study labor market outcomes for workers around these switches. We find that the increase in green jobs is small relative to the decline in high-automation-risk jobs. Green and low-automation-risk jobs attract workers who are more likely to be male, younger and higher educated. Moving into green or low-automation-risk jobs raises wages by 3.4% and 2.7% respectively, with more persistent gains for the latter. Leaving a brown job is associated with an 8.8% earnings loss, driven by reduced working hours, while exiting a high-automation-risk job shows no drop in earnings.
abstract_zh: 我们研究绿色转型与自动化对劳动力市场的影响，依据过去二十年的欧洲劳动力调查与荷兰行政数据。首先，我们考察欧盟14国就业存量的变化。其次，我们识别荷兰与转型相关的职业转换的个体与职业驱动因素。第三，我们采用事件研究方法考察劳动者在这些转换前后的劳动力市场结果。我们发现，绿色就业的增加相对于高自动化风险就业的减少而言规模较小。绿色与低自动化风险职业吸引的劳动者更可能为男性、较年轻且受教育程度较高。转入绿色或低自动化风险职业分别使工资提高3.4%和2.7%，其中后者的收益更具持续性。离开棕色职业伴随8.8%的 earnings 损失，其驱动因素是工作小时数减少，而退出高自动化风险职业则未显示 earnings 下降。
title: A tale of two transitions: Labor market adjustments to the green transition and technological change
title_zh: 双重转型的故事：劳动力市场对绿色转型与技术变革的调整

abstract: As climate-related extreme events become increasingly frequent and severe, their implications for government fiscal stability have become an important concern. Using panel data for 89 countries from 1993 to 2022, we examine the relationship between multidimensional climate physical risk and fiscal stress. A one-unit increase in the standardized Global Climate Physical Risk Index is associated with a 0.057-percentage-point increase in the fiscal deficit-to-GDP ratio. This association is stronger in countries with smaller economies, weaker business environments, smaller populations, and greater dependence on fossil fuels. Mechanism analyses reveal broad expenditure pressures but more selective revenue-side adjustments. Higher climate physical risk is associated with greater government expenditure, particularly on social protection, health, housing, and environmental protection, whereas aggregate government revenue does not respond significantly. Further analyses document associated changes in sectoral composition, labor force participation, and the balance between government revenue and expenditure.
abstract_zh: 随着气候相关极端事件日益频繁和严重，其对政府财政稳定的影响已成为重要关切。本文使用1993年至2022年89个国家的面板数据，考察多维气候物理风险与财政压力之间的关系。标准化全球气候物理风险指数每增加一个单位，财政赤字与GDP之比上升0.057个百分点。这一关联在经济规模较小、营商环境较弱、人口较少以及对化石燃料依赖程度较高的国家更强。机制分析揭示了广泛的支出压力，但收入侧的调整更具选择性。较高的气候物理风险与更高的政府支出相关，尤其是在社会保护、卫生、住房和环境保护方面，而政府总收入并未显著响应。进一步分析记录了部门构成、劳动力参与率以及政府收支平衡的相关变化。
title: Climate physical risk exposure and public finance vulnerability
title_zh: 气候物理风险暴露与公共财政脆弱性

abstract: Adapting the economic complexity framework to the micro level, this paper operationalizes digital knowledge complexity as a source of competitive advantage. Analyzing over 500,000 digital patents from China’s A-share listed firms from 2009 to 2020, it constructs a firm-level measure capturing diversity and ubiquity. Using markups as a proxy for market power, the analysis finds a positive association between digital knowledge complexity and market power, consistent with product and process innovation channels. This association is stronger for internally coherent or locally aligned portfolios but weakens in highly marketized regions, even among firms with strong non-digital bases. At the city level, higher digital knowledge complexity coincides with fewer new firm registrations. By connecting firm-level complexity to industrial organization outcomes, this paper clarifies the role of knowledge structure and offers policy implications, including stronger governance of overlapping digital rights and transparency measures that help firms connect portfolios to local capabilities.
abstract_zh: 本文将经济复杂性框架适配至微观层面，把数字知识复杂性操作化为竞争优势的来源。基于2009至2020年中国A股上市公司逾50万件数字专利，本文构建了捕捉多样性与普遍性的企业层面指标。以加成率作为市场势力的代理变量，分析发现数字知识复杂性与市场势力之间存在正向关联，这与产品和工艺创新渠道相一致。该关联在内部连贯或本地契合的专利组合中更强，但在高度市场化地区则减弱，即便在非数字基础较强的企业中也是如此。在城市层面，更高的数字知识复杂性与更少的新企业注册相伴。通过将企业层面复杂性与产业组织结果相连接，本文阐明了知识结构的作用，并提供了政策启示，包括加强对重叠数字权利的治理，以及有助于企业将专利组合与本地能力相衔接的透明度措施。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为中国A股上市公司2009-2020年的数字专利数据，制度与政策背景均涉及中国，属于直接相关。
title: Digital knowledge and market power: A firm-level analysis based on complexity theory
title_zh: 数字知识与市场势力：基于复杂性理论的企业层面分析

abstract: How has globalization affected OECD productivity growth since the 1990s? I develop and estimate an open-economy endogenous growth model in which firms compete strategically with both domestic and foreign rivals. Falling trade costs and stronger international knowledge spillovers expand foreign market size and initially raise innovation, particularly among leading firms, boosting short-run growth. However, this leader-biased response widens the domestic leader-follower technology gap and gradually weakens domestic competition: followers become discouraged, while leaders face diminishing returns from further innovation. Consequently, long-run growth gains are smaller than previous models predict and can even become negative. The model also connects globalization to broad macroeconomic trends in OECD countries and emerging markets, including a declining global output share of the OECD, rising industrial concentration, and higher R&D-to-GDP ratios.
abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代以来，全球化如何影响经合组织的生产率增长？我构建并估计了一个开放经济内生增长模型，其中企业与国内外竞争对手进行策略性竞争。贸易成本下降和国际知识溢出增强扩大了国外市场规模，并最初提升了创新，尤其是在领先企业中，从而推动了短期增长。然而，这种偏向领先者的反应扩大了国内领先者与追随者之间的技术差距，并逐渐削弱了国内竞争：追随者变得气馁，而领先者则面临进一步创新的收益递减。因此，长期增长收益小于先前模型的预测，甚至可能变为负值。该模型还将全球化与经合组织国家和新兴市场的广泛宏观经济趋势联系起来，包括经合组织全球产出份额下降、产业集中度上升以及研发占GDP比率上升。
title: Uneven firm growth in a globalized world
title_zh: 全球化世界中企业增长的不均衡

abstract: A common currency removes nominal exchange-rate adjustment across regions whose relative prices may not move together. When a region’s prices rise faster than those of its trading partners without a matching gain in productivity, its tradable sector loses competitiveness. Adjustment must then come through labor mobility, wage flexibility, or fiscal transfers; when these channels are blocked, it comes through borrowing. We ask whether such regional relative-price appreciation is associated with local government borrowing in China. Using customs micro-data, city consumer price indices, and bilateral exchange rates, we construct a city-level real effective exchange rate and derive a measure of cumulative real appreciation ( RA ) relative to each city’s trading partners. In a panel of 229 cities over 2005–2015, a one within-city standard-deviation increase in RA is associated with 1.8 percentage points faster growth of local government financing vehicle (LGFV) debt, about 5% of the sample mean. The association is concentrated in cities under greater economic pressure, with stricter hukou barriers to out-migration, with more binding minimum wages, and with weaker fiscal positions, and it extends to the price of debt: RA is positively associated with the offering spreads of urban construction and investment bonds. Inside a currency union, regional relative-price pressure that the classical adjustment channels cannot absorb shows up in sub-national borrowing.
abstract_zh: 共同货币消除了相对价格可能不同步变动的各区域之间的名义汇率调整机制。当一个地区的价格上涨快于其贸易伙伴，而生产率却没有相应提升时，其可贸易部门便会丧失竞争力。此时，调整必须通过劳动力流动、工资灵活性或财政转移来实现；当这些渠道受阻时，调整便通过借贷来实现。我们考察这种区域相对价格升值是否与中国地方政府借贷相关联。利用海关微观数据、城市消费者价格指数和双边汇率，我们构建了城市层面的实际有效汇率，并推导出相对于各城市贸易伙伴的累计实际升值（RA）指标。在2005—2015年229个城市的面板数据中，城市内RA每增加一个标准差，地方政府融资平台（LGFV）债务的增长速度便加快1.8个百分点，约为样本均值的5%。这种关联集中于经济压力较大、户籍制度对人口外迁限制更严、最低工资约束更强以及财政状况更弱的城市，并且延伸至债务价格：RA与城市建设投资债券的发行利差呈正相关。在货币联盟内部，经典调整渠道无法吸收的区域相对价格压力会表现为次国家层面的借贷。

title: Regional real appreciation and local government debt in China
title_zh: 中国地区实际升值与地方政府债务

abstract: In a seminal paper, Andreoni (1995) found higher rates of public goods provision in the same economic environment when presented as positive externalities for public good provision vs. negative externalities for private consumption. Andreoni commented that “the warm-glow of creating a positive externality appears to be stronger than the cold-prickle of creating a negative externality.” In this note I show that, under a natural interpretation, higher provision under positive externalities can emerge under perfect symmetry and even when the cold-prickle looms larger than warm-glow, while the opposite behavioral asymmetry can emerge when warm-glow looms larger than the cold-prickle.
abstract_zh: 在一篇开创性论文中，Andreoni（1995）发现，在同一经济环境下，当以公共品供给的正外部性而非私人消费的负外部性来呈现时，公共品供给率更高。Andreoni评论道：“创造正外部性的温暖光辉似乎比创造负外部性的寒冷刺骨更为强烈。”在本注记中，我表明，在一种自然解释下，正外部性下更高的供给可以在完全对称的情况下出现，甚至当寒冷刺骨比温暖光辉更为突出时也能出现，而当温暖光辉比寒冷刺骨更为突出时，相反的行为不对称也可能出现。
title: A note on warm-glow and cold-prickle
title_zh: 关于暖光与冷刺的注记

abstract: Urban residents increasingly purchase or construct second homes in surrounding rural settlements for leisure and temporary stays, creating new forms of interaction between urban demand and rural land and livelihoods. Although second-home development is often regarded as an opportunity for rural revitalization and economic diversification, its actual contribution to host communities remains uncertain, particularly in areas where land-use governance and institutional capacity are limited. This study examines the socio-economic effects of second-home tourism on rural households in Ferdows County, eastern Iran, with a focus on livelihoods, land-use change, and relations between local residents and second-home owners. The study uses survey data collected from 320 rural households in 14 villages and applies quantitative and spatial analyses to assess economic and social outcomes. The results indicate that second-home tourism has generated only limited local development benefits. Economic outcomes, including employment generation, income diversification, and local investment, remain weak, while social outcomes are characterized by tensions between permanent residents and second-home owners, declining social cohesion, and unequal access to services. Significant differences among villages further reveal the uneven spatial distribution of these impacts. The findings further suggest that fragmented institutional coordination and limited community participation have constrained the potential benefits of second-home development. Overall, the study shows that urban demand for second homes does not necessarily translate into rural development. Its local consequences depend in important ways on how land-use is governed and how local communities are involved in planning and decision-making. An integrated policy framework is therefore required to regulate land-use, strengthen local governance, align second-home development with regional sustainability objectives, and ensure meaningful community participation in planning and decision-making.
abstract_zh: 城市居民越来越多地在周边乡村聚落购买或建造第二住宅，用于休闲和临时居住，从而形成了城市需求与乡村土地及生计之间新的互动形式。尽管第二住宅开发常被视为乡村振兴和经济多元化的机遇，但其对东道社区的实际贡献仍不确定，尤其是在土地利用治理和制度能力有限的地区。本研究考察第二住宅旅游对伊朗东部费尔道斯县农村家庭的社会经济影响，重点关注生计、土地利用变化以及当地居民与第二住宅业主之间的关系。研究使用从14个村庄320个农村家庭收集的调查数据，并应用定量和空间分析来评估经济与社会结果。结果表明，第二住宅旅游仅产生了有限的本地发展效益。包括就业创造、收入多元化和本地投资在内的经济结果仍然疲弱，而社会结果则表现为常住居民与第二住宅业主之间的紧张关系、社会凝聚力下降以及服务获取不平等。村庄之间的显著差异进一步揭示了这些影响在空间分布上的不均衡。研究结果还表明，制度协调的碎片化和社区参与的有限性制约了第二住宅开发的潜在效益。总体而言，研究表明，城市对第二住宅的需求并不必然转化为乡村发展。其本地后果在很大程度上取决于土地利用如何治理以及当地社区如何参与规划和决策。因此，需要一个综合政策框架来规范土地利用、加强地方治理、使第二住宅开发与区域可持续发展目标相协调，并确保社区在规划和决策中进行有意义的参与。
title: Urban-driven second-home expansion and uneven transformation in peri-urban settlements: Socio-economic implications and planning challenges
title_zh: 城市驱动的第二住宅扩张与城郊住区的不均衡转型：社会经济影响与规划挑战

abstract: Understanding the economic impacts of drought remains challenging, particularly in identifying causal effects and accounting for regional heterogeneity. This paper applies the Synthetic Control Method (SCM) to estimate the impact of the 2017–2020 drought on economic returns to agricultural labour across three main agricultural regions in New South Wales, Australia. Using a 30‐year panel from the ABARES Australian Agricultural and Grazing Industries Survey, we construct counterfactual trajectories for total cash receipts per unit of labour to assess how outcomes would have evolved in the absence of drought. The results reveal substantial spatial heterogeneity in both the magnitude and persistence of impacts: the North West region experienced a decline of approximately 57% but recovered by 2022, the Central West shows persistent losses relative to its counterfactual by 2022, and the Riverina exhibits only limited deviations, suggesting greater resilience. These findings highlight that drought impacts differ not only in severity but also in recovery dynamics across regions and demonstrate the value of SCM as a transparent and replicable approach for estimating regional economic impacts using publicly available data, with important implications for place‐based drought policy.
abstract_zh: 理解干旱的经济影响仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在识别因果效应和考虑区域异质性方面。本文应用合成控制法（SCM）估计2017—2020年干旱对澳大利亚新南威尔士州三个主要农业区域农业劳动经济回报的影响。利用来自ABARES澳大利亚农业和放牧业调查的30年面板数据，我们构建了单位劳动总现金收入的反正事实轨迹，以评估在无干旱情况下结果本会如何演变。结果揭示了影响在幅度和持续性上均存在显著的空间异质性：西北部地区经历了约57%的下降，但到2022年已恢复；中部西部地区到2022年相对于其反正事实仍表现出持续损失；而Riverina仅表现出有限偏离，表明其具有更强的韧性。这些发现突出表明，干旱影响不仅在各区域之间的严重程度上不同，而且在恢复动态上也存在差异，并证明了SCM作为一种透明且可复现的方法，在利用公开可得数据估计区域经济影响方面的价值，这对基于地方的干旱政策具有重要启示。
title: Drought Impacts and Recovery Across Agricultural Regions: Evidence on Farm Economic Returns to Labour From a Synthetic Control Analysis
title_zh: 干旱影响与农业区域恢复：基于合成控制分析的农场劳动经济回报证据

abstract: Amid overlapping economic crises, many countries face renewed pressure to devalue their currencies. Yet, despite extensive research, the effects of devaluation on national income remain insufficiently understood. This study examines the income effects of the 1994 CFA franc devaluation on Franc Zone economies using two new indicators—Revealed Comparative Income (RCI) and Revealed Comparative Export (RCX)—which measure a country’s relative position in global income and export hierarchies. We find that for most Franc Zone countries, both RCI and RCX declined in the short and long term. The only exception is Equatorial Guinea, a small country with fewer than two million people, whose position improved due to oil discovery and exploitation. The short-term declines in RCI and RCX inevitably lead to reductions in nominal GDP right after devaluation. Combined with production expansion, this implies greater resource use alongside middle-class contraction. More fundamentally, devaluation often weakens a country’s capacity to generate income internationally, making it stuck in a lower position in the global hierarchy. Therefore, extreme caution is warranted when considering devaluation policies for developing economies.
abstract_zh: 在经济危机叠加的背景下，许多国家再次面临货币贬值的压力。然而，尽管已有大量研究，贬值对国民收入的影响仍未被充分理解。本研究采用两个新指标——显性比较收入（RCI）和显性比较出口（RCX）——考察1994年非洲法郎贬值对法郎区经济体的收入效应，这两个指标衡量一国在全球收入与出口层级中的相对位置。我们发现，对大多数法郎区国家而言，RCI和RCX在短期和长期均出现下降。唯一例外是赤道几内亚，这个人口不足两百万的小国因石油的发现与开采而地位改善。RCI和RCX的短期下降必然导致贬值后名义GDP立即减少。结合生产扩张，这意味着资源使用增加与中产阶级收缩并存。更为根本的是，贬值往往削弱一国在国际上创造收入的能力，使其困于全球层级的较低位置。因此，发展中经济体在考虑贬值政策时应极为谨慎。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为1994年CFA法郎贬值对法郎区经济体的影响，数据与制度背景均不涉及中国、香港或台湾。
title: The income effects of currency devaluation: Franc zone economies and their post-devaluation performance in the global hierarchy
title_zh: 货币贬值的收入效应：法郎区经济体及其贬值后在全球等级体系中的表现

abstract: The transportation sector is a major source of urban air pollution. Using county-level monthly panel data from China for 2007–2019, this paper evaluates two rounds of the low-carbon transport systems pilot policy introduced in 2011 and 2012 through a staggered difference-in-differences design. The fully controlled baseline specification indicates an approximately 2.1% reduction in monthly PM2.5 concentrations, statistically significant at the 5% level. Mechanism analyses provide evidence consistent with cleaner and more efficient energy use, changes in transportation structure, and expanded public transit as potential channels. Evidence from the spatial and heterogeneity analyses is less uniform: the fully controlled PM2.5 spillover estimate and the direct-effect estimate after excluding neighbouring cities are statistically insignificant, while the subgroup results do not establish statistically significant differences in policy effects across local characteristics. The findings provide evidence of a modest reduction in air pollution in pilot areas, while warranting caution in interpreting the spatial reach and heterogeneity of the policy’s effects.
abstract_zh: 交通部门是城市空气污染的主要来源。本文使用2007—2019年中国县级月度面板数据，通过交错双重差分设计评估2011年和2012年推出的两轮低碳交通系统试点政策。全控制基准设定表明，月度PM2.5浓度约下降2.1%，在5%水平上具有统计显著性。机制分析提供的证据与更清洁、更高效的能源使用、交通结构变化以及公共交通扩展作为潜在渠道相一致。空间分析和异质性分析的证据则不那么一致：全控制的PM2.5溢出估计以及排除邻近城市后的直接效应估计在统计上不显著，而分组结果未能确立政策效应在不同地方特征之间存在统计显著差异。研究结果提供了试点地区空气污染适度下降的证据，同时对解释政策效应的空间范围和异质性需保持谨慎。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Road to clean skies: assessing the effects of low-carbon transport systems policy on monthly air pollution
title_zh: 通往清洁天空之路：评估低碳交通系统政策对月度空气污染的影响

abstract: This study examines the impact of supply chain digitalization (SCD) on firms’ capacity utilization. Drawing on the structure–conduct–performance framework in industrial organization, we conceptualize supply–demand imbalances as structural conditions, firms’ competitive strategies as conduct, and capacity utilization as performance. This framework suggests that SCD increases capacity utilization by improving supply–demand matching and facilitating product quality upgrading. We construct two new measures of SCD from patent data using dictionary-based and supervised text classification methods. Using panel data on Chinese listed manufacturing firms, we estimate two-way fixed-effects models and a complementary difference-in-differences specification based on the Supply Chain Innovation and Application Pilot Program. We find that SCD significantly increases capacity utilization. Mechanism analyses show that SCD is associated with smaller production–demand deviations and faster inventory turnover, consistent with improved supply–demand matching. SCD is also associated with higher markups, more quality-upgrading activity, and larger within-industry market shares, consistent with product quality upgrading. Overall, these findings identify SCD as an important mechanism for alleviating capacity underutilization.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察供应链数字化（SCD）对企业产能利用率的影响。基于产业组织理论中的结构—行为—绩效框架，我们将供需失衡概念化为结构条件，将企业竞争策略视为行为，将产能利用率视为绩效。该框架表明，SCD通过改善供需匹配和促进产品质量升级来提高产能利用率。我们利用基于词典的方法和有监督文本分类方法，从专利数据中构建了两种新的SCD测度。基于中国制造业上市公司面板数据，我们估计了双向固定效应模型，并基于供应链创新与应用试点项目进行了补充性的双重差分设定。我们发现，SCD显著提高了产能利用率。机制分析表明，SCD与较小的生产—需求偏差和更快的存货周转相关，这与供需匹配改善相一致。SCD还与更高的加成率、更多的质量升级活动以及更大的行业内市场份额相关，这与产品质量升级相一致。总体而言，这些发现将SCD识别为缓解产能利用不足的重要机制。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为中国上市制造业企业，并使用中国供应链创新与应用试点政策作为准自然实验，数据、制度与政策背景均直接涉及中国。
title: Supply chain digitalization and capacity utilization: a structure–conduct–performance analysis
title_zh: 供应链数字化与产能利用率：基于结构—行为—绩效的分析

abstract: Rural e-commerce has become an important channel for expanding rural households’ market participation, yet adoption remains limited and uneven. Using data from the 2020 China Rural Revitalization Survey and a conditional mixed-process framework with a village-level instrument for reform completion, this study examines the relationship between rural collective property rights reform and household e-commerce adoption and explores land reallocation as a potential mechanism. The results show that rural collective property rights reform is positively associated with household e-commerce adoption. Land transfer is measured by both binary participation indicators and transfer ratios. Although results vary between these measures, the ratio specifications provide the clearest mechanism-consistent evidence: reform completion is associated with greater land transfer-in and transfer-out intensities, while transfer-in intensity is positively associated with adoption and transfer-out intensity is negatively associated with it. These relationships are evident for online sales of agricultural products but not non-agricultural products, consistent with production-expansion and agricultural-exit channels. Heterogeneity analyses suggest stronger reform associations among higher-income households and larger-scale land operators, but no significant variation by human capital. The findings highlight the potential role of collective asset governance in rural e-commerce adoption and the relevance of land reallocation and household production capacity.
abstract_zh: 农村电子商务已成为扩大农户市场参与的重要渠道，但其采用率仍然有限且不均衡。本研究利用2020年中国乡村振兴调查数据，采用条件混合过程框架并以村级改革完成度作为工具变量，考察农村集体产权制度改革与农户电子商务采用之间的关系，并探讨土地再分配作为潜在机制。结果表明，农村集体产权制度改革与农户电子商务采用呈正相关。土地流转以二元参与指标和流转比例两种方式衡量。尽管不同衡量方式的结果存在差异，但比例设定提供了最清晰的机制一致性证据：改革完成度与更高的土地转入强度和转出强度相关，而转入强度与电子商务采用呈正相关，转出强度与电子商务采用呈负相关。这些关系在农产品线上销售中表现明显，而在非农产品中不明显，这与生产扩张和农业退出渠道相一致。异质性分析表明，改革关联在较高收入农户和较大规模土地经营户中更强，但在人力资本方面无显著差异。研究结果凸显了集体资产治理在农村电子商务采用中的潜在作用，以及土地再分配和农户生产能力的重要性。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Rural collective property rights reform, land reallocation, and e-commerce adoption: evidence from rural China
title_zh: 农村集体产权制度改革、土地再分配与电子商务采纳：来自中国农村的证据

abstract: This paper studies how residence rights shape the native-welfare effects of foreign-worker admissions when native and foreign labor are imperfect substitutes and foreign-background children require compensatory public-school resources. We develop an overlapping-generations general-equilibrium model comparing a restricted-residence regime, in which foreign workers work in the host country but conduct childrearing and retirement abroad, with an open-residence regime, in which foreign workers may settle with their families. Under restricted residence, higher admissions can raise native steady-state welfare when native and foreign labor are sufficiently weak substitutes, even if native wages fall, because the education channel is absent and general-equilibrium adjustments through capital accumulation and the interest rate may offset wage losses. Under open residence, family settlement activates an education-resource burden. The marginal welfare effect of admissions decomposes into a non-education component and an education-resource component, yielding a closed-form threshold for the relative public-school resource requirement. Under open residence, a marginal increase in foreign-worker admissions raises native welfare when the non-education gains are sufficiently large relative to the compensatory education-resource burden. The results show that the welfare effect of foreign-worker admissions depends jointly on labor-market substitutability, residence rights, and the public-school resources required to educate foreign-background children in the host country.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在外籍劳动力与本国劳动力为不完全替代品、且外籍背景儿童需要补偿性公立学校教育资源的情况下，居住权如何塑造外籍劳工准入对本国福利的影响。我们构建了一个世代交叠一般均衡模型，比较两种制度：限制居住制度下，外籍劳工在东道国工作，但在国外抚养子女和退休；开放居住制度下，外籍劳工可携家庭定居。在限制居住制度下，当本国与外国劳动力的替代性足够弱时，即使本国工资下降，更高的准入量也可能提高本国稳态福利，因为教育渠道不存在，且通过资本积累和利率的一般均衡调整可能抵消工资损失。在开放居住制度下，家庭定居激活了教育资源负担。准入的边际福利效应分解为非教育成分和教育资源成分，得出相对公立学校资源需求的闭式阈值。在开放居住制度下，当非教育收益相对于补偿性教育资源负担足够大时，外籍劳工准入的边际增加会提高本国福利。结果表明，外籍劳工准入的福利效应共同取决于劳动力市场替代性、居住权以及东道国教育外籍背景儿童所需的公立学校资源。
title: Residence rights and native welfare: the education channel under imperfect substitutability
title_zh: 居住权与本土福利：不完全替代下的教育渠道

abstract: This paper examines the effect of Italy’s Law 215/2012, which introduced gender-balanced double-preference voting in municipal councils, on attacks against local politicians. Using a staggered difference-in-differences design focusing on municipalities with 5000–15,000 inhabitants, we find that the reform increases both the probability and the number of attacks in high-incidence regions—namely Apulia, Calabria, and Campania. We provide suggestive evidence on the underlying mechanisms. In these regions, the reform increases women’s representation in municipal councils and is associated with higher educational attainment among politicians, including mayors and aldermen, who are more exposed to violence. These changes appear to make political bodies less permeable to external pressure aimed at extracting private benefits. Consistent with this interpretation, the reform leads to an increase in both attacks characterized by criminally coded intimidation and those with broader retaliatory features. However, we find no effect on indicators of corruption risk in public procurement, suggesting that the phenomenon is unlikely to be driven by large-scale corruption
abstract_zh: 本文考察意大利第215/2012号法律对地方政治家遭受攻击的影响，该法律在市议会中引入了性别平衡的双重优先投票制。采用针对5000至15000名居民市镇的交错双重差分设计，我们发现该改革在高发地区——即普利亚、卡拉布里亚和坎帕尼亚——增加了攻击的概率和数量。我们提供了关于潜在机制的提示性证据。在这些地区，该改革提高了女性在市议会中的代表性，并与包括市长和市议员在内的政治家更高的教育水平相关，而这些政治家更容易遭受暴力。这些变化似乎使政治机构对外部压力——旨在获取私人利益——的渗透性降低。与这一解释一致，该改革导致以犯罪编码恐吓为特征的攻击以及具有更广泛报复特征的攻击均有所增加。然而，我们发现对公共采购中腐败风险指标没有影响，这表明该现象不太可能由大规模腐败驱动。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 252
title: Gender quotas, political selection, and violence. Evidence from high-incidence areas in Italy
title_zh: 性别配额、政治选拔与暴力：来自意大利高发地区的证据

abstract: In most Global South cities, peri-urban land operates like the new gold. The peri-urban frontier has increasingly become a site of intense land commodification, as financialization transforms land from a source of agro-based livelihoods into a speculative asset devoid of any collective or social significance. This paper adds to the emerging work on the uneven geographies of speculative land transformations by examining how the financialization of peri-urban land generates a crisis of social reproduction, undermining households’ capacity to secure livelihoods, housing, and food. Drawing on a qualitative case study approach and in-depth interviews with peri-urban residents and key-informants in the Agona West Municipality, the study findings highlight the systemic exclusion of women from peri-urban land transactions, intensification of gender inequalities in accessing productive resources, and the erosion of social care and support systems. The findings further reveal the rapid transformation of traditional livelihood systems from predominantly agrarian to informal and precarious urban labour. The paper fronts the need for urban development and land management frameworks that safeguard livelihoods, promote equitable land use, and reconcile development with social justice. By foregrounding the intersection of land financialization and social reproduction systems, the paper contributes to emerging discourses on just urban transitions in the often-overlooked smaller and intermediate towns of the Global South.
abstract_zh: 在全球南方大多数城市，城郊土地如同新的黄金。随着金融化将土地从农业生计的来源转变为一种不具有任何集体或社会意义的投机资产，城郊边疆日益成为土地商品化剧烈发生的场所。本文加入关于投机性土地转型不均衡地理的新兴研究，考察城郊土地的金融化如何生成社会再生产危机，削弱家庭保障生计、住房和粮食的能力。基于定性案例研究方法以及对阿戈纳西市城郊居民和关键知情人的深度访谈，研究发现凸显了女性被系统性地排斥于城郊土地交易之外、获取生产性资源方面性别不平等的加剧，以及社会照护与支持体系的侵蚀。研究结果进一步揭示了传统生计体系从以农业为主迅速转变为非正规且不稳定的城市劳动。本文提出，需要建立能够保障生计、促进公平土地利用并协调发展与社会正义的城市发展和土地管理框架。通过突出土地金融化与社会再生产体系的交汇，本文为关于全球南方常被忽视的小型和 intermediate 城镇公正城市转型的新兴讨论作出贡献。
title: On the land rush in the peri-urban frontier: Land financialization and the crisis of social reproduction in Ghana
title_zh: 论城郊边疆的土地争夺：加纳的土地金融化与社会再生产危机

abstract: We examine how negative environmental and social (E&S) incidents affect consumer behavior and firms’ responses. Using high-frequency store-visit data from SafeGraph linked to firm E&S incidents from RepRisk, we find that negative incidents lead to a modest decline in store visits on average, with substantially larger reductions among more environmentally and socially conscious consumers in Democratic-leaning areas. The effects are stronger for more severe and influential incidents, among younger and more educated consumers, for firms with higher pre-incident advertising intensity and E&S ratings, and in more competitive markets. Following these incidents, firms temporarily reduce discretionary disclosures and increase advertising expenditures over the longer run. Together, the results highlight consumer behavior as a way in which E&S incidents affect firm cash flows and suggest that firms adjust disclosure and advertising following these incidents.
abstract_zh: 我们考察负面环境与社会（E&S）事件如何影响消费者行为及企业应对。利用与RepRisk企业E&S事件相关联的SafeGraph高频门店访问数据，我们发现负面事件平均导致门店访问量小幅下降，而在倾向民主党的地区，环境与社会意识更强的消费者中降幅显著更大。对于更严重和影响更大的事件、年轻和受教育程度更高的消费者、事前广告强度和E&S评级更高的企业以及竞争更激烈的市场，效应更强。在这些事件发生后，企业暂时减少自愿性披露，并在较长时期内增加广告支出。总体而言，结果凸显消费者行为是E&S事件影响企业现金流的一种途径，并表明企业在这些事件后调整披露和广告。
title: From incidents to outcomes: consumer reactions and firm responses to negative environmental and social practices
title_zh: 从事件到结果：消费者对负面环境与社会实践的反应及企业应对

abstract: The market for rare earth elements is relatively small in value, but shortages can lead to disproportionate output losses. This column introduces a network model to quantify the output losses from a large and permanent shortage of rare earth elements. At short horizons less than one year, GDP losses range from 0.6% in the UK to 1.5% in the US and 1.8% in Japan. Supply chain risk assessments need to incorporate production networks to understand the vulnerabilities from such disruptions. Policymakers should build strategic reserves and develop domestic capacity to help withstand the short-run losses from rare earth shortages.
abstract_zh: 稀土元素市场的价值相对较小，但供应短缺可能导致不成比例的产出损失。本专栏引入一个网络模型，以量化稀土元素大规模且永久性短缺所带来的产出损失。在不到一年的短期内，GDP损失从英国的0.6%到美国的1.5%和日本的1.8%不等。供应链风险评估需要纳入生产网络，以理解此类中断带来的脆弱性。政策制定者应建立战略储备并发展国内产能，以帮助抵御稀土短缺造成的短期损失。
authors: Christian Bogmans, Maximiliano Jerez Osses, Jorge Miranda-Pinto, Jean-Marc Natal
china_relevance_reason: 研究稀土供应中断对英国、美国、日本等经济体的宏观影响，未以中国为研究对象或数据背景。
title: Macroeconomic effects of rare earth supply disruptions
title_zh: 稀土供应中断的宏观经济效应

abstract: The EU's decision to phase out Russian natural gas imports raises concerns about the economic consequences of the ban, particularly its timing and uneven regional impacts. This paper examines how the wholesale gas price effects of eliminating Russian supplies depend on changing market conditions, including global LNG availability, infrastructure development and European gas demand. Using a European gas market model, we compare the impacts of an immediate phase-out under 2024 market conditions with those of a gradual phase-out under projected 2028 conditions, while distinguishing the effects of the ban from broader market developments. The results show that an immediate phase-out would lead to significant regional price increase, particularly in Central and South-Eastern Europe (4-5 €/MWh), where infrastructure constraints limit access to alternative supplies. By contrast, under projected 2028 market conditions, the ban would increase average EU wholesale gas prices by only 0.3 €/MWh and gas procurement costs by approximately 1%. Extending the phase-out to neighbouring non-EU countries would increase costs, particularly in the Western Balkans. Global market circumstances have by magnitude greater impact on absolute price levels than the Russian gas phaseout itself. The findings suggest that a coordinated phase-out of Russian gas can be achieved with limited additional wholesale market costs, provided that sufficient alternative supplies and infrastructure are available. They also highlight the importance of regional cooperation and continued supply diversification to mitigate uneven impacts across European gas markets.
abstract_zh: 欧盟逐步停止进口俄罗斯天然气的决定引发了对该禁令经济后果的担忧，尤其是其实施时机与不均衡的区域影响。本文考察消除俄罗斯供应对批发电气价格的影响如何取决于不断变化的市场条件，包括全球液化天然气可得性、基础设施建设以及欧洲天然气需求。我们运用欧洲天然气市场模型，比较在2024年市场条件下立即逐步停止与在预测的2028年条件下渐进逐步停止的影响，同时将禁令效应与更广泛的市场发展区分开来。结果表明，立即逐步停止将导致显著的区域价格上涨，尤其是在中东欧和东南欧（4-5欧元/兆瓦时），这些地区的基础设施约束限制了对替代供应的获取。相比之下，在预测的2028年市场条件下，该禁令仅使欧盟平均批发电气价格上涨0.3欧元/兆瓦时，天然气采购成本增加约1%。将逐步停止范围扩大至邻国非欧盟国家将增加成本，尤其是在西巴尔干地区。全球市场环境对绝对价格水平的影响在量级上大于俄罗斯天然气逐步停止本身。研究结果表明，只要具备充足的替代供应和基础设施，协调一致的俄罗斯天然气逐步停止可以在有限的额外批发市场成本下实现。研究还强调了区域合作和持续供应多元化的重要性，以缓解欧洲天然气市场之间的不均衡影响。
title: Can Europe afford to phase out Russian gas? How timing, global supply conditions, and demand shape wholesale gas prices
title_zh: 欧洲能否承受逐步淘汰俄罗斯天然气？时机、全球供应状况与需求如何塑造批发天然气价格

abstract: Temporary fuel-tax cuts are eventually restored, making both policy directions relevant for consumer incidence. Using ordinary and tax-exempt prices for the same gasoline and diesel in Korea, we compare two cuts and two restorations in 2018–2021. Over days 1–7 after each reform, full-sample, equal-event pass-through averages about 70% for cuts and 54–55% for restorations. Same-station comparisons and checks for sample composition, cost adjustment, and local shocks retain this point ordering. Pretrend and no-reform diagnostics nevertheless reveal differential price movements. Under stated restrictions, sensitivity bounds limit the size of a firm-favorable restoration-minus-cut gap, although the negative sign is less robust to departures from parallel trends. The results document incomplete initial consumer relief and lower estimated first-week pass-through when relief is withdrawn, with diagnostics quantifying the implications of differential price adjustment.
abstract_zh: 临时性燃油税削减最终会被恢复，这使得两个政策方向都与消费者税负归宿相关。利用韩国同一种汽油和柴油的普通价格与免税价格，我们比较了2018—2021年间的两次削减和两次恢复。在每次改革后的第1—7天，全样本、等事件的传导率平均约为削减70%、恢复54—55%。同站点比较以及对样本构成、成本调整和地方冲击的检验均保持这一排序。然而，预趋势和无改革诊断揭示了不同的价格变动。在所述限制条件下，敏感性边界限制了有利于企业的恢复减削减差距的规模，尽管负号对平行趋势偏离的稳健性较低。结果记录了初始消费者纾困不完整，以及在纾困撤回时估计的第一周传导率较低，诊断量化了差异化价格调整的含义。
title: Does what goes up come back down? Pass-through of fuel-tax cuts and restorations in Korea
title_zh: 上涨的会回落吗？韩国燃油税削减与恢复的传导效应

abstract: This paper revisits fiscal policy in a currency union using a behavioral New Keynesian model with cognitive discounting à la Gabaix (2020). Cognitive discounting reshapes the government spending multiplier through three channels: a non-Ricardian effect, as households underweight future taxes; an expectation-dampening effect, which weakens forward inflation transmission; and a TOT effect, which slows terms-of-trade adjustment. At the ZLB, the welfare gain from discretionary fiscal coordination is positive but small in the two-country model. Stronger cognitive discounting generally reduces this gain by weakening inflation expectation transmission. Moreover, the gains are asymmetric: the directly shocked country benefits more, while its partner also benefits over the empirically relevant calibration range of cognitive discounting.
abstract_zh: 本文运用Gabaix（2020）式认知折扣的行为新凯恩斯模型，重新审视货币联盟中的财政政策。认知折扣通过三个渠道重塑政府支出乘数：非李嘉图效应，即家庭低估未来税收；预期抑制效应，即削弱前瞻性通胀传导；以及贸易条件效应，即减缓贸易条件调整。在零利率下限处，两国模型中相机财政协调的福利收益为正但较小。更强的认知折扣通常通过削弱通胀预期传导而降低这一收益。此外，收益具有不对称性：直接受冲击国获益更多，而其伙伴国在认知折扣的经验相关校准范围内亦能获益。
title: Fiscal policy in a behavioral New Keynesian model for the currency union
title_zh: 货币联盟行为新凯恩斯主义模型中的财政政策
